'''Tanya Mane''', known by her nicknamed '''Tanya "Trickshot" Mane''', was a dark-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She made frequent stops to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] before the [[Invasion of Taris|Imperial invasion]] of the world, and could be found in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Olaris]] where she shared her knowledge with other smugglers.
